observations: Photo shows a black PS4 Slim console standing upright next to two sealed-looking DualShock 4 controller boxes
A watermark reading 'MR GAMEZ' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is overlaid on the image
No power cable, HDMI cable, or games are visible in the photo
No serial number, model sticker, or screen showing the console powered on is visible
Console body shows some light surface marks/dust consistent with used condition

identity.kind: PS4 slim console with two controllers
read_from: photo 0 console body and controller box PS4 logo

claims.evidence: No import documentation, UK plug adapter, or region sticker visible in photo 0
No screen-on shot showing custom firmware menu or jailbreak software in photo 0
Photo 0 shows two sealed-looking DualShock 4 boxes, but boxes being present does not confirm the controllers inside are new, genuine, or functional
No games, discs, or digital library screen shown in photo 0; claim text is also cut off

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have hardware faults (common in used/hacked units)
risks.proof: Video clip of console powering on to the home screen

risks.risk: Jailbreak/hack status unverifiable; hacked consoles can be unstable, lose warranty, or get banned from PSN
risks.proof: Screen recording showing the custom firmware menu and system version
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard used console with added risk discount, not as a premium 'enhanced' unit

risks.risk: Controllers may not be genuine new units despite sealed-looking boxes
risks.proof: Photo of opened box with controller and serial sticker, plus pairing test
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/unverified controllers, not new

risks.risk: Games claimed may not be included, may be pirated copies (consistent with hacked console), or may not run
risks.proof: Photo of game list on console or physical discs with titles visible
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, no games included

risks.risk: Hidden internal damage (HDD, fan, overheating) typical of used imports not visible externally
risks.proof: Video of console running for a few minutes showing fan noise and no overheating shutdown

proof_requests: Video of console powering on and reaching the home/XMB screen
Clear photo or video of the system settings showing firmware/jailbreak version
Photo of controllers out of the box with serial numbers visible
Photo or video showing the actual game titles included
Close-up photo of any model/serial sticker on the console underside
response.reason: The core claims that set this item apart from a baseline used PS4 Slim — that it is hacked/jailbroken, UK-sourced, and comes with working games and genuinely new controllers — are all unverifiable from a single static photo, and no power-on or firmware proof is shown; a worst-case price would effectively treat it as a non-functional shell, which is not a fair baseline until at least a power-on clip is provided.
